entries.0931628d2d484e6d: The company has a structure enabling integrated production from design to manufacturing in Japan and overseas, covering press processing of metal terminals, plating, and resin molding. The fact that the company designs and manufactures its molds in-house and sells precision molds and peripheral equipment along with its products forms a foundation that allows it to serve customers in both mass production of components and molds.
entries.0d9c02218ef3a165: The company has set a long-term management vision for fiscal 2021 through fiscal 2030, “Creating the Future through Mold Technology: Smaller, Faster, and Aiming to Be the Best Partner for Lifestyles and Business through Cutting-Edge Technology”, and is advancing a medium-term management plan that positions the three years from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026 as its 2nd STEP. Building on its core mold processing technology and combining new technologies derived from it, the company aims to contribute to the development and advancement of cutting-edge devices and to remain the most trusted business partner.
